# Syed Hadi

> Syed Hadi is a product marketing and channel partnerships lead at AccuKnox, a Zero Trust CNAPP and AI security company, based in Bengaluru, India. He sells Claude skills for marketers and runs "in a box" growth projects for B2B SaaS and security startups, built around a 90 day roadmap.

Engagements come in three sizes. Small projects run 30 days (phase one of the roadmap), medium projects run 45 days, and long term work is scoped on a call. Pricing is shared by email on request. Every call ends with a draft 90 day plan.

## Growth in a box
- [GTM + PMM in a box](https://syedcreates.com/gtm-pmm-in-a-box.html): GTM and PMM as one 90 day program. Positioning, ICP, outbound, partners, launch and a pipeline dashboard, with Syed as fractional growth lead.
- [GTM in a box](https://syedcreates.com/gtm-in-a-box.html): 90 day go to market program for B2B SaaS and security startups. ICP, outbound, partner program and a pipeline dashboard.
- [PMM in a box](https://syedcreates.com/pmm-in-a-box.html): 90 day product marketing program. Positioning, messaging, battlecards, sales enablement and a launch.
- [AEO/SEO Ranking in a box](https://syedcreates.com/aeo-seo-in-a-box.html): 90 day program to rank in Google and get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Audit, technical fixes, buyer pages and AI visibility tracking.
- [Content in a box](https://syedcreates.com/content-in-a-box.html): 90 day B2B content program. Strategy, calendar, long form articles, a gated asset, founder LinkedIn posts and distribution.
- [Schedule a meeting](https://syedcreates.com/schedule-meeting.html): free call on GTM, product marketing, AEO and SEO or content.

## Claude Skill Pack
- [Claude Skills for Marketers](https://syedcreates.com/skill-pack.html): 8 tested Claude skills for GTM teams. Prompt Polisher, Humanizer, Caveman Mode, Company Intel Dossier, UX Competitive Teardown, SEO Blog Grader, Content Calendar Studio and Webinar Calendar Link. Works in Claude.ai, the Claude desktop app and Claude Code.
- [How to install Claude skills](https://syedcreates.com/skill-pack.html#install): upload the zip in Claude settings, or copy the folder to ~/.claude/skills for Claude Code.
